diagnostics_not_gates.magnetic_moment_variation: per design in the dataset; never a gate

limitations.design_pooled_values: design averages of the per-cell estimates with declared weights (cell wall areas; launch counts as the v1-comparable alternative); they are summaries of the per-cell structure, not estimands in their own right
limitations.estimand: per catalogue cell: the fraction of electrons launched at the cell's launch plane (two radius bands, 5/25 eV, 20/70 deg, both directions, scrambled-Sobol gyrophase) that first reach the straight dielectric wall; a collisionless geometric wall-access fraction, NOT a Kornfeld per-cusp-transit loss probability and NOT a cusp probability for the plasma network without a declared closure
limitations.field_level: L1a linear constant-permeability axisymmetric equivalent-current FDM (cft_revival.fields); non-authoritative current bands, not a permanent-magnet material model, not P2 FEM, not hardware-valid (sweep rows); P2 adaptive FEM level-1 map through the v4 adapter (P2 row only)
limitations.orbit_model: collisionless prescribed-field relativistic-Boris test particles; no electric field, no collisions, no sheath, no self-consistent plasma
limitations.two_stage_estimator: the per-cell estimate pools stage-1 and stage-2 launches with equal weights; because the stage-2 sample size depends on the stage-1 counts, the pooled estimate carries an adaptive-allocation bias of order 1/n that is negligible against the floor; stage-1, stage-2 and pooled counts are all recorded so a consumer can use the stage-2-only estimate
usable_as: surrogate training labels per catalogue cell (surrogate v3) labelled SCREENING_L1A_FIELD_TEST_PARTICLE_WALL_LOSS with the per-cell floor
design- and cell-dependent geometric access fractions for the MDO closures CL-3-sheath-limited / CL-4-hybrid-area under their labels
a formal consumer of the orbit_mc coupling-v4.2 export format and of the v3.1 cusp-cell catalogue
